title: Group price indexes for baskets and sectors (COO ruling 38 Part B)
price_note: Total return = the dividend-adjusted close already used in the breadth history. Adjusted closes are today's restated values (split and dividend adjustment as of the Tiingo archive capture 2026-10-11..16), not the prices printed at the time. Data end 2026-10-09.
redistribution_note: Group-level index levels and counts only; no member prices, tickers or per-security dates. Member-level history stays off git.

index.rebalance_rule: engine.baskets._ew_level: equal-weight daily total-return level, cumprod of (1 + EW daily return) from 1.0 at the first active session; a member counts only inside its membership window
index.floor_rule: first date per key = earliest session with at least 5 priced members; rows below 5 keep n_priced_members with a blank index
index.floor_gap: below-floor sessions are blank; the chain stays flat across the gap and resumes from the last valid level

group_index_daily_dated.parquet.membership: S&P 500 dated membership (sp1500_pit_membership src=sp500) x as-of-now GICS sector classification (sp1500_pit_sectors); classification is as of now, NOT era-correct; same basis as #11094 group_breadth_daily_dated_sp500.parquet

group_index_daily_current_sensitivity.pa.membership: today's members applied to every past session; survivors only; not point-in-time

sector.engine_key_source: engine/neuralweb/sector_map.py GICS_TO_ETF (explicit code map) and engine/sector_cycles.py SECTORS / engine/subsector_rotation.py SECTOR_ETFS, keyed by the 11 SPDR sector ETF tickers
sector.engine_key: SPDR sector ETF ticker via GICS_TO_ETF

basket.engine_key_source: engine/us_basket_turn.py and engine/baskets.py read data/baskets/membership.json keyed by basket id; engine_key = basket id
basket.no_dated_file_reason: The basket membership on main carries added/removed fields, but added_semantics states `added` is an index-inclusion mask back-projected to seed_date (2023-05-09) for any roster curated later (35 of 49 baskets are back-projected), and `curated_added` is a recent curation stamp, not an era-correct entry date. membership_history.parquet holds only 4 snapshots (2026-08-13..2026-10-14). There is no historical point-in-time basket entry/exit record covering the price span, so a dated basket index would misrepresent hindsight-curated, back-projected rosters as genuine dated history. Baskets are therefore current members only, in the sensitivity file.

membership_census.note: All three dated S&P sources exist in sp1500_pit_membership.parquet with the desk's expected first dates. The committed dated sector index uses sp500 (the same basis as #11094 group_breadth_daily_dated_sp500.parquet). sp400/sp600 membership is available for a future extension; nothing was purchased or downloaded.

dropped_partial_rows_rule: centred 21-row median of priced names; a row under half is dropped (data cleaning, not a signal rule)
duplicate_series_rule: month-by-month hash of daily returns, then pairwise check: >=60 identical returns and >=95% identical between first and last identical session; the second ticker is counted once over the span. Detection and labelling only; no store repaired. Pair tickers are not committed (group-level counts only).
no_outcomes: Data only. Descriptive group levels and counts. No outcome relation, no backtest, no hit rate, no signal, ranking or score column.
engine: engine.baskets._ew_level; scripts/build_group_breadth_history.py dated loaders; scripts/build_tree_breadth_and_index.py group_index
